items.title: [AINews] Gemini 4 Argon: GDM’s answer to Astra/Fable, with 1M output
items.summary_1line: ... but you can’t try it yet unless you are “government users and trusted cyber defenders in the Fairwind Program”
items.editor_note: Independent framing against rival flagships, plus the access restriction.

editorial.tldr: Google DeepMind announced Gemini 4 Argon on Sep 30 as its next frontier model. Latent Space framed it a day later as DeepMind's answer to Astra and Fable, with 1M output tokens.
editorial.whats_new: Gemini 4 Argon is not yet open to general developers: Latent Space reports only government users and trusted cyber defenders in the Fairwind Program can try it.
editorial.why_it_matters: A 1M output limit matters for long agent runs, but with no general access you cannot benchmark or budget for it yet.
editorial.take_for_builders: Keep your current Gemini model pinned and do not plan capacity around Argon's 1M output until general API access and pricing are published.

status.detail: Announced Sep 30; access limited to the Fairwind Program per Latent Space.

beats.headline: Analysis: 1M output, but access limited to Fairwind Program users
